components.name: Typed relation/witness stabilization compiler boundary
components.project_addition: Consumes established monoid-weighted/balanced partition mathematics inside the R004 typed future-language compiler. Makes MAY, witness-count and witness-label-set semantics explicit channels; proves the finite unique-coarsest stable-refinement specialization and semantic factor-map refinement rule; gives equal-cardinality incomparable COUNT/LABEL-SET safe partitions; and isolates the compiler composition boundary that total-operation congruences combine by raw kernel meet while quotient-relative relation/witness aggregates may require stabilization after raw meet. A 3-state two-channel activation cascade and a 5-state same-channel raw-meet failure are executable counterexamples. Mother ownership remains P023/A4; historical novelty of the Enterprise Math packaging is unverified.
